card.name: Mixed connecting words in warnings
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on scattered small words and punctuation such as 'and', '.', 'that', 'of' in warning or patient-instruction text.

modes.label: Linking word after a stop instruction
modes.description: A joining word right after an instruction to discontinue a drug, before the next action.
